evidence_level: E2 ordinary native UI plus unchanged native_local_file originals; internal calls/model/Skill/network unverified
limits: Only the fixed six-line prompt was sent, once; no added follow-up, repair or retry.
Input supplied through the native new-task workspace picker; no attachment acceptance is claimed.
Internal file-read parameters and returned error state were not independently exposed. Ordinary final error quotation and JSON not_found are declarations.
Complete literal write payload was not visible. E2 byte equality does not establish E1 tool-call fidelity or causation.
Native local files were copied from the selected authorized workspace, not downloaded.
Folder picker screenshot API reported multiple regions; official images were displayed and visually checked, with AX/error records retained.
Some immediate post-action AX frames lagged the displayed UI; fresh captures were taken before dependent operations.
Application metadata contents were not read; backend sandbox or permission boundary was not tested.

input_read.basis: The ordinary final says it read inputs/probe.txt and reports the token, but actual read parameters and returned data are not independently visible.

missing_feedback.basis: The ordinary final quotes File does not exist and receipt declares not_found. No independent paired read request and returned error state are visible, so this does not establish E1 missing-file feedback.

write_fidelity.basis: The complete literal write payload is unavailable. Separately, external read-only validation found the native echo original equals the 91-byte input and receipt declaration has the required four fields.

permission.basis: The fixed file contract does not test a permission boundary. The existing visible permission was left unchanged; backend scope is unknown.

artifact_outcome.independent_validation: Evaluator read-only verify_outputs; not a product self-check
